sections.title: The Mez Systems principle
sections.feedback: Lock in A. Concentric: outer ring the business connections, inner ring the harnesses, product disc at the centre cycling through all five gradients.

design.composition: Three radii of one object rather than three stacked bands. Business connections hold the outer ring turning one way, harnesses the inner turning the other, and the product core sits still at the centre of both.
design.twoRegisters: A harness is a system the business is run from: named context, 25px, high opacity. A connection is a tool the business already uses: 17px, half opacity. The gap between the treatments is what says a harness is not a plugin.
design.productCycle: The core shows every product in the registry in turn. renderer.setCore() swaps a mounted surface's gradient without a second WebGL context but the swap is a hard cut, so the transition rides the exact static twins: fade the next product's twin in over the live canvas, swap underneath it, fade the twin back out. The element's CSS background follows so the no-WebGL fallback lands on the same product.
design.coreShape: Mounted as a canonical disc expression rather than a circle invented for the section.
design.greyPrefix: Removed, matching the correction Olli asked for in S02. head-quiet is now unused across the whole page.
